sources.title: Point Cloud Color Constancy
sources.authors: Xiaoyan Xing, Yanlin Qian, Sibo Feng, Yuhan Dong, Jiri Matas
sources.role: Measured RGB-D to illuminant estimation; inverse direction to the monocular thesis's desired CC-to-depth benefit
sources.access: CVF search/publication record and author arXiv HTML main paper plus appendix inspected; direct CVF PDF requests returned 403

sources.title: Official PCCC code and dataset release
findings: Parsed dataset argument is not passed to PcdColor
PCCC.forward unpacks two values where PointNetfeat returns three
CUDA and author-specific absolute paths require adaptation
Released output head has three channels and no explicit fourth attention channel described in the paper
Fold CSVs are not present in the inspected Git tree; inspect data release
Held-out fold repeatedly controls saved checkpoint in released train loop

sources.title: LumiDepth: Stable Monocular Depth in Multi-illumination Scenes
sources.authors: Anqi Cheng, Zhiyuan Yang, Tianjiao Li, Haiyue Zhu, Kezhi Mao
sources.role: Very close prior art: multi-illumination depth, disagreement-calibrated pseudo-supervision and frequency-aware consistency/distillation
sources.link_evidence: Publisher Notes footnote 1 explicitly links ReMID to this Drive folder
sources.access: Publisher preview and Notes inspected; full subscription-only chapter not acquired in this review
sources.caveat: Publisher footnote 2 uses normalized depth notation; asset units and scoring alignment need independent verification
